question: How many strategic accounts do we have today?

metrics.name: deliveries_90d
metrics.label: Deliveries (90 days)
metrics.definition: The number of non-cancelled deliveries whose requested delivery date falls in the 90 days ending on the as-of date.

metrics.name: on_time_deliveries_90d
metrics.label: On-time deliveries (90 days)
metrics.definition: Of the deliveries in the 90-day window, how many the carrier delivered on or before the date the customer asked for.

metrics.name: on_time_delivery_rate
metrics.label: On-time delivery rate (90 days)
metrics.definition: The share of deliveries that arrived on or before the customer's requested date, over the last 90 days. "Arrived" is the carrier's delivered event, not a ship date; cancelled deliveries do not count; a delivery not yet delivered by its date is late.

metrics.name: late_deliveries
metrics.label: Late deliveries (90 days)
metrics.definition: Deliveries in the last 90 days that arrived after the requested date, or have not arrived although the date has passed.

metrics.name: net_revenue
metrics.label: Net revenue (USD)
metrics.definition: Invoiced revenue minus credit memos, converted to US dollars at the monthly average exchange rate of each billing month.

metrics.name: open_shipping_tickets
metrics.label: Open shipping tickets
metrics.definition: Open support tickets about shipping: tagged shipping, delivery, late_delivery or logistics, or with a subject that mentions late, delay, shipment, delivery or tracking. Tickets on a look-alike duplicate account count toward the real customer.

metrics.name: renewals_due_120d
metrics.label: Renewals due in 120 days
metrics.definition: Open renewal opportunities that close within 120 days of the as-of date.

metrics.name: account_risk_flag
metrics.label: At-risk flag
metrics.definition: 1 when an account's on-time delivery rate is below 85% and it has two or more open shipping tickets or a renewal due in 120 days; otherwise 0. Combine with the strategic filter to get the at-risk strategic accounts.

dimensions.name: account__tier
dimensions.description: Tier at the end of the as-of date (today's tier).

dimensions.name: delivery__tier_at_delivery
dimensions.description: The customer's tier on the requested delivery date (history mode), not today's tier.

notes: Group by the entity `account` to get one row per customer, and `account__account_name` for its name.
`account__tier` is today's tier; `delivery__tier_at_delivery` is the tier in force on each delivery's date.
Delivery metrics already cover the 90 days ending on the as-of date (6 Nov 2026).

output.compiled_sql:
WITH rss_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    account_name
    , region
    , tier
    , is_strategic
    , customer_id AS account
  FROM "warehouse"."marts"."dim_account" accounts_src_10000
)
SELECT
  account AS account
  , account__account_name AS account__account_name
  , account__region AS account__region
  , account__tier AS account__tier
  , case when on_time_delivery_rate < 0.85 and (open_shipping_tickets >= 2 or renewals_due_120d > 0) then 1 else 0 end AS account_risk_flag
FROM (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(subq_10.account, subq_20.account, subq_30.account) AS account
    , COALESCE(subq_10.account__account_name, subq_20.account__account_name, subq_30.account__account_name) AS account__account_name
    , COALESCE(subq_10.account__region, subq_20.account__region, subq_30.account__region) AS account__region
    , COALESCE(subq_10.account__tier, subq_20.account__tier, subq_30.account__tier) AS account__tier
    , MAX(subq_10.on_time_delivery_rate) AS on_time_delivery_rate
    , COALESCE(MAX(subq_20.open_shipping_tickets), 0) AS open_shipping_tickets
    , COALESCE(MAX(subq_30.renewals_due_120d), 0) AS renewals_due_120d
  FROM (
    SELECT
      account
      , account__account_name
      , account__region
      , account__tier
      , CAST(COALESCE(__on_time_deliveries_90d, 0) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COALESCE(__deliveries_90d, 0), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS on_time_delivery_rate
    FROM (
      SELECT
        account
        , account__account_name
        , account__region
        , account__tier
        , SUM(deliveries_90d) AS __deliveries_90d
        , SUM(on_time_deliveries_90d) AS __on_time_deliveries_90d
      FROM (
        SELECT
          subq_1.account AS account
          , rss_10001_cte.account_name AS account__account_name
          , rss_10001_cte.region AS account__region
          , rss_10001_cte.tier AS account__tier
          , rss_10001_cte.is_strategic AS account__is_strategic
          , subq_1.__deliveries_90d AS deliveries_90d
          , subq_1.__on_time_deliveries_90d AS on_time_deliveries_90d
        FROM (
          SELECT
            customer_id AS account
            , case when is_in_90d_window then 1 else 0 end AS __deliveries_90d
            , case when is_in_90d_window and is_on_time then 1 else 0 end AS __on_time_deliveries_90d
          FROM "warehouse"."marts"."fct_delivery" deliveries_src_10000
        ) subq_1
        LEFT OUTER JOIN
          rss_10001_cte
        ON
          subq_1.account = rss_10001_cte.account
      ) subq_5
      WHERE account__is_strategic = true
      GROUP BY
        account
        , account__account_name
        , account__region
        , account__tier
    ) subq_8
  ) subq_10
  FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT
      account
      , account__account_name
      , account__region
      , account__tier
      , COALESCE(__open_shipping_tickets, 0) AS open_shipping_tickets
    FROM (
      SELECT
        account
        , account__account_name
        , account__region
        , account__tier
        , SUM(open_shipping_tickets) AS __open_shipping_tickets
      FROM (
        SELECT
          subq_12.account AS account
          , rss_10001_cte.account_name AS account__account_name
          , rss_10001_cte.region AS account__region
          , rss_10001_cte.tier AS account__tier
          , rss_10001_cte.is_strategic AS account__is_strategic
          , subq_12.__open_shipping_tickets AS open_shipping_tickets
        FROM (
          SELECT
            customer_id AS account
            , case when is_open and is_shipping_related then 1 else 0 end AS __open_shipping_tickets
          FROM "warehouse"."marts"."fct_ticket" tickets_src_10000
        ) subq_12
        LEFT OUTER JOIN
          rss_10001_cte
        ON
          subq_12.account = rss_10001_cte.account
      ) subq_16
      WHERE account__is_strategic = true
      GROUP BY
        account
        , account__account_name
        , account__region
        , account__tier
    ) subq_19
  ) subq_20
  ON
    (
      subq_10.account__account_name = subq_20.account__account_name
    ) AND (
      subq_10.account__region = subq_20.account__region
    ) AND (
      subq_10.account__tier = subq_20.account__tier
    ) AND (
      subq_10.account = subq_20.account
    )
  FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT
      account
      , account__account_name
      , account__region
      , account__tier
      , COALESCE(__renewals_due_120d, 0) AS renewals_due_120d
    FROM (
      SELECT
        account
        , account__account_name
        , account__region
        , account__tier
        , SUM(renewals_due_120d) AS __renewals_due_120d
      FROM (
        SELECT
          subq_22.account AS account
          , rss_10001_cte.account_name AS account__account_name
          , rss_10001_cte.region AS account__region
          , rss_10001_cte.tier AS account__tier
          , rss_10001_cte.is_strategic AS account__is_strategic
          , subq_22.__renewals_due_120d AS renewals_due_120d
        FROM (
          SELECT
            customer_id AS account
            , case when is_due_in_120d then 1 else 0 end AS __renewals_due_120d
          FROM "warehouse"."marts"."fct_renewal" renewals_src_10000
        ) subq_22
        LEFT OUTER JOIN
          rss_10001_cte
        ON
          subq_22.account = rss_10001_cte.account
      ) subq_26
      WHERE account__is_strategic = true
      GROUP BY
        account
        , account__account_name
        , account__region
        , account__tier
    ) subq_29
  ) subq_30
  ON
    (
      COALESCE(subq_10.account__account_name, subq_20.account__account_name) = subq_30.account__account_name
    ) AND (
      COALESCE(subq_10.account__region, subq_20.account__region) = subq_30.account__region
    ) AND (
      COALESCE(subq_10.account__tier, subq_20.account__tier) = subq_30.account__tier
    ) AND (
      COALESCE(subq_10.account, subq_20.account) = subq_30.account
    )
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(subq_10.account, subq_20.account, subq_30.account)
    , COALESCE(subq_10.account__account_name, subq_20.account__account_name, subq_30.account__account_name)
    , COALESCE(subq_10.account__region, subq_20.account__region, subq_30.account__region)
    , COALESCE(subq_10.account__tier, subq_20.account__tier, subq_30.account__tier)
) subq_31
LIMIT 200

answer.answer_summary: Torvane has 25 strategic accounts as of 6 November 2026 (count of distinct account IDs flagged strategic in the account dimension). The count does not depend on the stale Zendesk feed, but any ticket-based figures would.

metrics_used.name: account_risk_flag
metrics_used.definition: 1 when an account's on-time delivery rate is below 85% and it has two or more open shipping tickets or a renewal due in 120 days; otherwise 0. Combine with the strategic filter to get the at-risk strategic accounts.

lineage: warehouse.marts.dim_account (account__is_strategic) -> account_risk_flag (grouped by account, filtered to account__is_strategic = true)
assumptions: 'Strategic' means accounts with is_strategic = true in the governed account dimension (dim_account), as of today.
Each row returned by the query is one distinct account ID; the 25 rows have 25 different account names, so I found no duplicate strategic accounts.
The as-of date is 6 November 2026, as instructed.
caveats: Zendesk last synced successfully on 9 Nov 2026 and its latest attempt failed (API rate limit), so it is outside the 24-hour window. The strategic account count does not use Zendesk, so it is not affected. Open shipping ticket counts and at-risk flags do depend on Zendesk and may be understated until it syncs.
The freshness check was stamped 11 Nov 2026, after the 6 Nov as-of date, so the 'age' figures are measured from 11 Nov. I have not reconciled this timing gap.
Account IDs 0000100015 and 0000100016 do not appear in the strategic list. I did not check whether they exist as non-strategic accounts.
